scripts.test:e2e: PORT=$(bash scripts/find-dev-server.sh) && [ "$PORT" != "0" ] && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:$PORT playwright test --workers=1 || echo "❌ No dev server found for this project"
scripts.test:e2e:chromium: PORT=$(bash scripts/find-dev-server.sh) && [ "$PORT" != "0" ] && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:$PORT playwright test --project=chromium --workers=1 || echo "❌ No dev server found for this project"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web exec -- tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter shared exec -- tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:type: pnpm --filter shared exec -- tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter web exec -- tsc --noEmit
